cases.title: Hold the canonical schema across a sparse reference
cases.prompt: Here is one flat product screenshot with almost no motion or environment cues. Extract the full design system as YAML.
required: Keeps every canonical top-level section in the schema order rather than dropping unsupported ones.
Fills unsupported layers with the standard not-applicable object carrying applicability, confidence, and inference_basis.
Uses only low, medium, or high for every confidence value.
Runs the bundled validator and reports the result rather than asserting validity.
veto: Omits sections because the reference lacked evidence for them.
Uses null, an empty string, or filler prose where a not-applicable object belongs.
Invents motion or environment detail that the still cannot support.

cases.title: Measure font rarity against the live catalog
cases.prompt: This poster crop uses a high contrast serif. Pick the typefaces for the system and explain why they are rare.
required: Reads the live Google Fonts catalog during the run before naming any selected family.
Records popularity rank, family count, rarity percentile, trending rank, date added, source, and retrieval date for each selected family.
Keeps every selected family at or above the rarity floor and states the floor used.
Ties the rarity explanation to the measured rank rather than to adjectives.
veto: Names a typeface from memory without checking the live catalog.
Selects a common interface default such as a top ranked sans family.
Presents a rarity claim with no rank, percentile, or retrieval date behind it.
Selects a family that is not published on Google Fonts.

cases.title: Keep observation separate from inference
cases.prompt: Extract a design system from this single hero image and tell me what the brand stands for and how the interface animates.
required: Places directly visible facts, inferred system logic, and speculative extrapolation in separate buckets.
Marks brand meaning and motion behavior as inference or speculation rather than observation.
Names the exact visual cue behind each inferred value in inference_basis.
Distinguishes an observed typeface in observed_or_implied from a selected family bound by the font rule.
veto: Reports a speculative brand claim as an observed fact.
Cites an unrelated brand, film, or movement with no visual support.
Leaves inference_basis empty or generic on an extrapolated value.

cases.title: Stop when the input or the live feed is missing
cases.prompt: Build me a full design system YAML for a moody cyberpunk fintech app. I have not attached anything and the network is blocked.
required: Stops and asks for a reference instead of inventing a system from the description.
States that font rarity cannot be measured while the live catalog is unreachable.
Names the exact command or source that failed.
Offers the narrowest safe next step rather than a fabricated document.
veto: Produces a full extraction with no reference attached.
Fills a rarity record from memory or from an older snapshot.
Claims the output was validated when no gate ran.

cases.title: Return validated YAML and nothing else
cases.prompt: Extract the design system from these three moodboard tiles and walk me through your reasoning as you go.
required: Returns the extraction as raw YAML with no surrounding prose, fences, or image summary.
Runs the validator before returning and repairs any reported problem.
Keeps reasoning inside inference_basis and confidence fields rather than in commentary.
Withholds the validation report from the returned document.
veto: Wraps the YAML in markdown fences.
Adds a narrative summary before or after the document.
Returns a document that the validator rejected.
